headline: **MLB Daily Recap: May 22, 2026**
article:
The Cleveland Guardians secured a 3-1 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Joey Cantillo earning the win after 5.2 innings of scoreless relief. Dillon Dingler led the Guardians' offense with a home run and 1 RBI. In other action, the Pittsburgh Pirates took down the St. Louis Cardinals 6-2 behind Braxton Ashcraft's 7.0 innings of work, striking out 9 batters and allowing just 1 earned run.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Brenton Doyle of the Colorado Rockies, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left oblique contusion. The Atlanta Braves have also transferred Hurston Waldrep from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow surgery. Other teams have also made roster moves, with the Cincinnati Reds acquiring right-handed pitcher Zach McCambley from the Miami Marlins.

The Reds made a trade to acquire McCambley, sending right fielder Rece Hinds to the Marlins. The Tampa Bay Rays also made a trade, sending left-handed pitcher Joe Rock to the Chicago White Sox in exchange for third baseman Oliver Dunn. The Toronto Blue Jays traded left-handed pitcher Eric Lauer to the Los Angeles Dodgers for cash, while the Athletics traded center fielder Junior Perez to the Chicago White Sox for left-handed pitcher Jackson Nove.

top_news.summary: The New York Mets edged out the Washington Nationals 2-1, securing a crucial win. David Peterson earned the win for the Mets, while Devin Williams secured the save.

top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves dominated the Miami Marlins, securing a 9-3 victory. Michael Harris II led the Braves' offense with a pair of home runs and three RBIs.
